Good to know

Your TipMint
questions, answered.

Who is TipMint for?

TipMint is built for servers, bartenders, waiters, waitresses and other workers whose earnings change from shift to shift.

Does TipMint calculate tax or payroll?

No. Earnings are estimates based on the hours, wages and tips you enter. TipMint does not calculate tax or payroll deductions.

Do I need an account?

No TipMint account is required. Shift records stay on your device; Apple or Google Play handles billing for optional Pro access.

How do I get help with TipMint?

Email info@digitalsprout.org with your device, app version and a description of the issue. You can also visit our support page.
